description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST in RENEWING does NOT carry Option 50 (Requested IP Address) (RFC 2131 §4.3.6 table 5)
approach:
[Objective]
In RENEWING the address being renewed is already in ciaddr (REQUEST_08 covers that), so Option 50 would duplicate it. Table 5 in RFC 2131 §4.3.6 lists Option 50 as MUST NOT in renewing/rebinding.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING → renew DHCPREQUEST.
   • options blob does NOT contain Option 50   ← key check

[Pass condition]
No Option 50 inside the RENEWING REQUEST options blob.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_renewing_request_carries_requested_ip — REQUEST illegally carries Option 50.

verdicts.Pass: RENEWING REQUEST has no Option 50 — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_renewing_request_carries_requested_: DUT renewing REQUEST illegally carries Option 50
